name: Sensei
source:
A man of Japanese origin with a bushy mustache he's very proud of. His main trait is his ability to absorb knowledge and a phenomenal memory. He will outsmart his opponents because he’s better prepared and because he can assess a situation faster.
He has never felt the need for friends but recently he has found himself anticipating the next time he and Lézard will run into each other.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31464]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
